text: {"lessons":["Selling some Stock B after a 23.8% gain felt satisfying, but I should not let the urge to lock in gains drive decisions by itself.","I made no trades as the account fell, which avoided impulsive reactions; I should base future choices on risk and the portfolio, not recent price moves.","These few periods do not reveal a reliable pattern in random prices, so I should stay diversified and avoid treating past changes as forecasts."]}
